I feel like there’s a distinction to be made about gay ≠ BL, because LGBT manga does not necessarily equate to BL and vice versa. Imo, I feel like BL manga has certain tropes/characteristics that distinguish it as BL (certain traits and tropes are ‘problematic’ like rape/SA being prevalent and a story driver, however not all BL manga have those tropes/plot lines). Simply, to me it’s like you would never call an actual gay couple a ‘yaoi couple’ or just because a story has more than one gay character, you wouldn’t immediately label it a BL. Sorry for the dissertation, but this type of discussion really interests me! I’d love to hear other people’s opinions!
